lines.en: Mia, did you speak to the new director? She told me she was leaving the next day.
lines.pt: Mia, você falou com a nova diretora? Ela me disse que ia viajar no dia seguinte.

lines.en: Yes, she told me the same. She said she had to catch a flight to Chicago that night.
lines.pt: Falei, ela disse a mesma coisa. Disse que tinha que pegar um voo para Chicago naquela noite.

lines.en: Strange. Yesterday she said she would be here all week, and she told us the meeting was on Thursday.
lines.pt: Estranho. Ontem ela disse que estaria aqui a semana toda, e disse que a reunião era na quinta.

lines.en: Right. This morning she said the meeting was that afternoon, and then she cancelled it.
lines.pt: É. Esta manhã ela disse que a reunião era naquela tarde, e depois a cancelou.

lines.en: I asked her what had happened, and she said she had been called to a client’s office the day before.
lines.pt: Perguntei o que tinha acontecido, e ela disse que tinha sido chamada ao escritório de um cliente no dia anterior.

lines.en: So maybe she wanted to say that she was visiting a client, not that she was leaving the company.
lines.pt: Então talvez ela quisesse dizer que ia visitar um cliente, não que ia sair da empresa.

lines.en: Maybe. She told me she would be back the following week, and she asked me to cover for her.
lines.pt: Talvez. Ela me disse que voltaria na semana seguinte e pediu que eu a cobrisse.

lines.en: She asked me too. She said she had sent the report two days before, but I never got it.
lines.pt: Ela também me pediu. Disse que tinha enviado o relatório dois dias antes, mas eu nunca recebi.

lines.en: I checked the email. She said she had sent it the previous Monday, but the date shows last Friday.
lines.pt: Eu verifiquei o e-mail. Ela disse que tinha enviado na segunda anterior, mas a data mostra sexta passada.

lines.en: That explains it. She told us that she would reply to all our messages by the end of that week.
lines.pt: Isso explica. Ela nos disse que responderia a todas as mensagens até o fim daquela semana.

lines.en: Typical! Let us write down what she said, so that nobody gets confused next week.
lines.pt: Típico! Vamos anotar o que ela disse para que ninguém fique confuso na semana que vem.

facts.big: She said she was leaving the next day
facts.label: Mudança de tempo e expressão de tempo
facts.sub: Depois de said, o tempo recua e as expressões de tempo mudam: tomorrow vira the next day.

facts.label: passar para o passado
facts.sub: Present simple vira past simple, present continuous vira past continuous, will vira would, can vira could. She said she was leaving. O tempo recua um passo.

facts.label: mudar palavras de tempo
facts.sub: Tomorrow vira the next day, today vira that day, yesterday vira the day before, now vira then. This week vira that week e last week vira the previous week.

pages.title: An office in Denver · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy Wednesday morning in Denver. Gabe and Luisa share a desk near the window. The new director gave them different news every day. Now they try to remember what she really said. Words like tomorrow and yesterday change when we report. Today they practise tenses and time expressions.

“Luisa, did you speak to the new director? She told me she was leaving the next day.” says Gabe. “Yes, she told me the same. She said she had to catch a flight to Chicago that night.” says Luisa. “Strange. Yesterday she said she would be here all week, and she told us the meeting was on Thursday.” says Gabe.
